author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (signing-standin)
providerMode: Isolated local DocuSign protocol stand-in (fixture/server.mjs, a JS port of e2e/tests/docusign.ts at the tested commit) on the lab backend network, with DOCUSIGN_BASE_URL and SIGNING_STANDIN set on app and worker by fixture/signing-overlay.yml. No real provider account, invitation, or external signing. Deliveries were signed with a per-run in-memory Connect secret. Not C42 evidence.
browser: Playwright Chromium (headless) from the worktree e2e dependencies, one context per identity at 1280x1800 CSS px

identities.legal_team_member flow: sender Nadia Haddad; Legal Owner Priya Raman; unrelated Legal Team Member Marcus Oyelaran; voider Daniel Okafor as Administrator (neither sender nor Legal Owner); rival sender Priya Raman
identities.administrator flow: sender Daniel Okafor; Legal Owner Nadia Haddad (voider, rival sender); unrelated Legal Team Member Priya Raman
identities.both: Ravi Menon, a Business User added to each Contract team, signed in by a fresh magic link

setupByApi: Contract creation with its Legal Owner, the two primary Document Versions and the supporting Document upload, the team add, archive and restore used the lab API as prerequisites. Everything the article instructs (Status move, Approvals, the Send and Void dialogs, Executed copy, Documents) used the browser. Connector configuration used the Settings page as setup; the configure-signing guide owns those steps.
observations: After a refused void (the provider had already completed the round), an immediate reload still showed Out for signature. The Signed outcome appeared only after the provider feed arrived. The article says to reload and inspect the recorded outcome; the in-dialog message says the ending arrives from the provider feed.

In Polling mode the first provider check came 3.5 minutes after completion, at the first 5-minute sweep for a new Envelope. The 15 to 20 minute interval applies between later checks (reconciliation.ts) and was not measured.
Business User Ravi Menon (the former Contributor account) is refused Envelope reads and sends (403). The article does not address this audience.

An earlier attempt of this script failed on a harness assumption (the DocuSign section of Settings collapses after the connector is turned off). The connector was removed and the whole main phase was rerun; only the complete rerun is recorded here.
